12: /-- Longitudinal momentum at fixed positive transverse mass. -/

20: theorem longitudinal_bijective (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) :
21:     Function.Bijective (longitudinal r) := by

23:   · intro x y h
24:     apply Real.sinh_injective
25:     exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr.ne' h
